## Core Specializations

### 1. Website & Web Application Development
- **Technologies**: React, TypeScript, Next.js, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Node.js, RESTful APIs, Git.
- **Deliverables**: Ultra-fast responsive landing pages, business portfolio sites, custom web applications, mobile-first frontend interfaces, and accessible design (WCAG compliance).
- **Architecture**: Clean component-driven modular code, performance optimization, SEO-friendly SSR/SSG patterns.

### 2. Digital Marketing & Paid Ad Campaigns
- **Platforms**: Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram Ads), Google Ads (Search & Display), TikTok Ads, Business Social Media Management.
- **Methodology**: High-conversion ad copy, scroll-stopping visual creatives, custom audience targeting, pixel integration, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and ROAS maximization.
- **Experience**: Experienced handling business accounts and scaling campaigns (e.g., at Beasyai and for private clients).

### 3. Professional Video Editing & Motion Graphics
- **Tools**: Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Audition, DaVinci Resolve.
- **Expertise**: Motion graphics, educational video production, 2D animation, character animation, color grading, sound design, YouTube thumbnail design, and visual branding.
- **Featured Works**: Produced and edited a complete library of 29+ children's educational videos including Urdu alphabet series (حروفِ تہجی), phonics lessons, nursery rhymes, and story animations.
